t: Whereabouts Of Mr. James Reid Martin

pages.en:
Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council

'Milford'
Kilmacolm
Renfrewshire
Scotland
14/12/36

Dear Sir,

In reply to your letter
No D 7588, of November 7th, I wish to
thank you most sincerely for your
efforts to trace my brother, James Reid Mathie.
I am sorry that all your enquiries
have proved fruitless. It was most
kind of you to try to trace him. Please
accept my heartfelt thanks.

I am
Yours gratefully
(signed) Mrs. Frances R. West.
pages.zh:
致警务处处长，
上海公共租界工部局

“米尔福德”宅
基尔马尔科姆
伦弗鲁郡
苏格兰
1936年12月14日

尊敬的先生：

就您11月7日第D 7588号来函，我谨对您为查找我的兄弟詹姆斯·里德·马西（James Reid Mathie）所付出的努力表示最诚挚的感谢。
很遗憾，您的所有查询均无结果。承蒙您费心查找，不胜感激。请接受我衷心的感谢。

此致
敬礼

（签名）弗朗西斯·R·韦斯特夫人

pages.en:
November 7 36.

Mrs. Frances R. Weir,
Millford,
Kilmacolm,
Renfrewshire,
Scotland.

Madam,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your
letter dated October 10, 1936, and to inform
you that despite careful enquiries, no trace of
your brother, Mr. James Reid Martin, can be found
in Shanghai. His name and other particulars
have been noted and any information received
concerning his whereabouts will be communicated
to you.

I am, Madam,
Your obedient servant,

Commissioner of Police.

（批：KB）
pages.zh:
1936年11月7日。

致弗朗西斯·R·韦尔夫人，
米尔福德宅，
基尔马尔科姆，
伦弗鲁郡，
苏格兰。

女士：

兹确认收到您1936年10月10日的来信，并告知您，尽管进行了仔细查询，在上海仍未发现您兄弟詹姆斯·里德·马丁先生的任何踪迹。其姓名及其他详细信息已予记录，一旦收到有关其下落的任何信息，将立即通知您。

此致
敬礼

警务处处长

（批注：KB）

G. 45M-1-36
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
C.S.6, Special Branchxxxxx
REPORT
Date Nov. 7, 19 36.
Subject Whereabouts of Mr. James Reid MARTIN.
Made xxx and Forwarded by D. S. Jones.
Inquiries made at various hotels, the British
Consulate Passport Office, Salvation Army, St. Andrew's Society,
Hanbury Institute, Chinese Passport Office and other likely
places, with the object of tracing a Mr. James Reid MARTIN,
native of Glasgow, have met with no result.
As it was thought likely that the young American
named "Jay" Reed MARTIN now detained in Ward Road Gaol might
know something of a man whose name so nearly resembles his
own, I visited him in Gaol (with the written permission of the
U. S. Court Marshal) on November 6th and questioned him on
this point. No information, however, could be obtained from
this quarter regarding the subject of this enquiry.
The name and other particulars have been entered on
Boarding House records and should he ever come to notice a
further report will be submitted.
D. S.
D. C. Special Branch.

G. 45M-1-36
上海公共租界警务处。
档案编号
C.S.6，特别处xxxxx
报告
日期：1936年11月7日。
事由：詹姆斯·里德·马丁先生的下落。
由 D. S. Jones 制作并转发。
为查找格拉斯哥籍人士詹姆斯·里德·马丁先生，已在各旅馆、英国领事馆护照办公室、救世军、圣安德烈协会、汉伯里研究所（Hanbury Institute）、中国护照办公室及其他可能地点进行查询，但均未获结果。
鉴于认为目前拘押在提篮桥监狱的美籍青年“杰伊”·里德·马丁（"Jay" Reed MARTIN）可能了解一些关于这位姓名与其极为相似之人的情况，本人于11月6日持美国法院法警的书面许可前往监狱探视并就此向其询问。然而，从此方面未能获得与本查询事项有关的任何信息。
该姓名及其他详细信息已录入寄宿公寓记录中，若日后有所发现，将另行提交报告。
D. S.
特别处副督察。

pages.en:
FILE NO. 21 1/2
'Milford',
Kilmacolm
Renfrewshire
Scotland
10/10/36

To
The Municipal Council,
Shanghai.

Dear Sir,
I wonder if you could put
me in touch with James Reid Martin
who I hear has been recently in Shanghai.
He is a native of Glasgow, Scotland,
5ft. 11 inches in height, brown eyes, dark
hair (may be bald or grey) aged 54.
Any information will be gladly
received by me, his sister.
Thanking you in anticipation
I am
yours very truly
(Mrs) Frances R. Reid.
pages.zh:
档案编号 21 1/2
“米尔福德”宅，
基尔马尔科姆
伦弗鲁郡
苏格兰
1936年10月10日

致
上海公共租界工部局。

尊敬的先生：
不知您能否协助我与詹姆斯·里德·马丁取得联系，据闻他最近曾在上海。
他是苏格兰格拉斯哥人，身高5英尺11英寸，褐色眼睛，深色头发（可能秃顶或花白），年龄54岁。
作为他的姐姐，我将欣然接受任何相关信息。
预先致谢

此致
敬礼

（夫人）弗朗西斯·R·里德
